name: v1.4.0 - visual editor, custom artwork and correctness fixes
body:
## New features

- Visual editor for players, artwork, voice icons and layout.
- Optional game_images overrides with automatic image-error fallback.
- Actual selected image source and image link in player details.
- Shared entity indexing and skipped player rebuilds for unrelated Home Assistant updates.

## Fixes

- Session time can no longer be borrowed from another player playing the same game.
- Steam busy/looking-to-play/looking-to-trade presence is handled correctly.
- Offline toggle overrides the initial hide setting.
- Steam lookup uses bounded failure caching, timeout and unique normalized title matching.
- Gamers sort first inside voice groups too.

## Migration

Set session_entities to the correct Gaming Status sensors for each player requiring a timer. Direct Gaming Status Xbox sensors can still provide their own sessions. Unlinked timers are omitted rather than guessed. Gaming Status remains optional.

Includes regression tests and updated README/CHANGELOG.
